name: Quetzaltenango
pointBasis: Exact WUP2025 population-weighted settlement point in latitude/longitude order; not shifted to force a parcel hit.
registryBasis: The official Registro de Información Catastral de Guatemala (RIC) Geoportal exposes a public cadastral map and GeoServer WFS. The official Municipalidad de Quetzaltenango portal separately evidences a Dirección de Catastro, Avalúos e IUSI. No city-hosted parcel geometry API was identified.
technicalBlocker: The public national WFS is technically usable and returned anonymous geometry elsewhere in Guatemala, but the exact WUP point and bounded Quetzaltenango envelopes returned zero features. No city-specific parcel identity/geometry sample was available for safe retention or adapter qualification.
scopeLimits: Zero bounded hits are not evidence of citywide cadastral absence. The tested envelope was limited to the WUP point and nearby city area; no citywide completeness audit or municipal-boundary query was performed.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official RIC Geoportal backed by GeoServer WFS layer GEO_RIC:PREDIO.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Capabilities/schema were public; an unbounded maxFeatures=1 request returned one safe-looking polygon elsewhere in Guatemala, while Quetzaltenango bounded requests returned zero features.
